facts.summary: Interim weight loss met endpoint but fell short of investor hopes, with GI discontinuations · Phase 2 · pemvidutide in obesity · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Mean weight loss of 10.7% (placebo-adjusted 9.7%) at 2.4 mg dose at Week 24
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: p < 0.001 at all three doses vs placebo, efficacy estimand using a mixed model of repeated measures [MMRM] analysis
evidence.safety: One subject (2.4%) experienced a serious adverse event of nausea and vomiting requiring rehydration at the 2.4 mg dose.
